description: Use this to see which fax numbers an organization has blocked. Faxes from them are deleted as they arrive. Returns 25 at a time, newest first. Pass next_page back as page for more. Needs the person to sign in to Faxette. It changes nothing.

organization.description: The organization's id from get_organizations. Ask the person which one if there are several.

page.description: The next_page from the previous call.

name: get_blocked_senders

next_page.description: Pass it as page for the next 25. Null on the last page.

title: List blocked numbers
